# has software name

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasSoftwareName`](gmeow-hasSoftwareName.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSoftwareName>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

Relates a project or product to a structured [`gmeow:SoftwareName`](../classes/gmeow-SoftwareName.md) it bears; the software-scoped specialization of [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md). Non-functional — a project may bear many co-equal names; none is primary.

**Property shape:** object property; `?` -> [`gmeow:SoftwareName`](../classes/gmeow-SoftwareName.md)
